// Puzzle data for Witness, the daily scene-memory game (owner, 2026-11-12).
// Imported ONLY by the server page (app/witness/page.js), which filters
// live<=today before handing puzzles to the client, so future scenes and
// answers never reach a browser.
//
// GENERATED by scripts/gen-witness.mjs, deterministically off each date. Never
// hand-edit a board, and never regenerate one that has gone live: the generator
// may only append days. scripts/verify-witness.mjs re-proves every answer from
// the scene itself.
//
// THE GAME. A street scene shows for `study` seconds (20, 30 on Sunday), then
// disappears, and the player answers `qs` from memory: six questions, eight on
// Sunday, four options each, one right. Score is the number right; the clock
// breaks ties. Nothing is graded until the last answer, when the scene comes
// back with a numbered pin on each thing asked about.
//
// THE WEEKLY RAMP (the scene gets more detailed, the clock never shortens):
//   Mon, Tue  tier Gentle    2 shops, 1 vehicle; plain recall
//   Wed, Thu  tier Moderate  3 shops, a clock, a bus stop, birds; counts, small text
//   Fri, Sat  tier Tough     4 numbered shops, twin vehicles; relations and traps
//   Sunday    tier Tough     the fullest street, eight questions, thirty seconds
// `objects` is how many separate things the scene shows, and the verifier holds
// each tier to its band. No Sunday Edition flag: Sunday is simply the week's
// biggest board, as on Tangled.
//
// Fields. scene: { shops: [{ name, wall, tall, windows, door, awning?: { color,
// striped }, clock?: { h, m }, number? }] left to right; sky: { sun, clouds:
// [slot], birds?: { slot, n }, flyer?: { slot, kind, color? } }; walk: [{ slot
// 0..11, kind, color?, hat?, umbrella?, route? }]; road: [{ slot 0..2, kind,
// color, rack? }] }. Drawn by lib/witness-scene.js.
// qs: [{ t: the question, o: four options, a: index of the right one, k: the
// kind of question, ref: what it asks about (the verifier re-derives the
// answer from scene + k + ref), at: [x, y] for the reveal pin or null }].
